scope: Five generated concepts for training, progression, personal speed rewards, and a personal pet. No game integration or save changes.
databaseMigrations: Not applicable: standalone static image gallery; no game or database state is loaded.

renderedChecks.method: Playwright screenshots plus measured visible overlay hosts; screenshots visually inspected. Text and numbers are HTML overlays, not generated bitmap text.

visualFindings: Titles and action labels fit their plates without overlap.
Training and progression receive equal visual weight; neither is preselected in the introductory choice.
Portraits associate each co-op choice with its player.
MathBoard clearly separates current problem power from accumulated turn power; a wrong answer preserves the prior total.
Key choice and reward illustrations remain visible and meaningful with words hidden and without audio.
Correct, wrong, and quick states use symbols and numbers as well as color.
limits: Concept review only; not approval for production UI or gameplay balance.
Stats and reward quantities are illustrative.
Co-op selection is an illustrated state; only MathBoard review controls are interactive.
Animation, narration, gameplay input states, and child playtesting are not assessed.
Production should retain the established mana icon and separate reusable frames, icons, runtime text, and interaction states.
Production comparison-size baseline and Canvas/WebGL rendering must be verified when integrating with the shared MathBoard.
